limitations: CICIDS2017 is the production training source, so these results are not an independent generalization estimate.
Rows are sampled by label from full capture files; a file-level split of the existing model training data is unavailable.
Infiltration and Heartbleed are handled by separate rare-family detectors and are not part of the multiclass encoder.
rare_family_detector_note: Reported scores use the active rare-family artifacts. They were trained on all CICIDS2017 data, so these source-aligned results are in-sample and optimistic.
